description:
Use this when you need US federal employee or federal-office holiday status for 2026-2027. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need a state/local/private-employer/exchange calendar or an alternate federal work schedule without explicit in-lieu resolution.
What it computes: Checks a date against the OPM federal-employee holiday schedule and the US Saturday/Sunday baseline.
Example user requests: Is 2027-07-05 a US federal working day?
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2027-07-05"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_observed, holiday_actual_dates, weekend_days, rest_day_policy, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, source_quality, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = US weekday baseline and no OPM federal holiday
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/us-federal-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/us-federal-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in the pinned OPM 2026-2027 coverage.

name: check_us_federal_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Federal employees and federal offices only.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, regular weekend or OPM federal holiday.

holiday_actual_dates.description: Underlying statutory holiday dates for observed events.

holiday_names.description: OPM federal holiday names applying on the date.

holiday_observed.description: True when the date is the OPM in-lieu/observed date for a holiday whose actual date is a weekend.

is_working_day.description: True when the US Saturday/Sunday baseline is a weekday and no OPM federal holiday applies.

rest_day_policy.description: OPM alternative work schedules need separate in-lieu resolution.

source_quality.description: Official OPM schedule and federal-law references.

sources.description: Official OPM, federal guidance and legislation sources.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: US Federal Holiday Working Day
